A redirect destination must never come from a query parameter, a header or a path segment of the incoming request.\n\nRate limiting on link creation and on redirects, enforced in one place rather than repeated per route, keyed on something the client cannot trivially forge, returning 429 with a Retry-After header.\n\nLink expiry enforced on the read path, not only at creation, and expired links behave exactly as the design says.\n\nA health endpoint that reports liveness without touching user data.\n\nConfiguration from environment variables with safe defaults. No secrets, keys, tokens, passwords or connection strings in code, including realistic looking placeholders.\n\nParameterized SQL only. Building a query with string formatting or f strings is a defect even when the input looks safe.\n\nNever use eval, exec, os.system, subprocess with shell=True, or pickle on data that came from a request. There is no acceptable use of these in this service.\n\nError responses use one stable JSON shape and never carry a stack trace, a database error string or a filesystem path.\n\nEvery function has a fully type annotated signature and a docstring saying what it does, what it returns and what it raises. Use timezone aware datetimes throughout; naive timestamps are how expiry logic goes wrong across a deployment boundary.\n\nPaths are relative to the workspace root with POSIX separators.\n\nBind to the design's configuration list exactly. Use the environment variable names and defaults it gives you and do not invent your own, even when a different name reads better. Implementation and test authoring run concurrently and never see each other's output, so the design is the only place the two can agree.\n\nReturn one JSON object matching the schema. No prose outside it.", "text": "{\"files\":[{\"path\":\"requirements.txt\",\"content\":\"fastapi==0.115.6\\nstarlette==0.41.3\\npydantic==2.10.4\\nuvicorn==0.34.0\\nidna==3.10\\nhttpx==0.28.1\\npytest==8.3.4\\n\"},{\"path\":\"README.md\",\"content\":\"# links — public URL shortening service\\n\\nA small FastAPI + SQLite service that issues short redirect links.\\n\\n* `POST /links` — create a short link (unauthenticated, per-IP rate limited).\\n* `GET /{code}` — 302 redirect to the stored destination (re-validated at read time).\\n* `GET /healthz` (alias `GET /health`) — liveness, touches no user data.\\n\\n## Running\\n\\n```\\npip install -r requirements.txt\\npython -m app.main\\n```\\n\\n## Configuration (environment variables)\\n\\n| Name | Default | Purpose |\\n| --- | --- | --- |\\n| `LINKS_DB_PATH` | `./links.db` | SQLite file path; `:memory:` accepted for ephemeral runs. |\\n| `LINKS_BIND_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Bind interface. |\\n| `LINKS_BIND_PORT` | `8080` | Bind port (plain HTTP behind a TLS-terminating proxy). |\\n| `LINKS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | `https://short.example.com` | Origin used to build `short_url`. |\\n| `LINKS_DEFAULT_EXPIRY_DAYS` | `30` | Expiry applied when the caller omits `expires_in_days`. |\\n| `LINKS_MAX_EXPIRY_DAYS` | `365` | Inclusive upper bound for `expires_in_days`. |\\n| `LINKS_MAX_URL_LENGTH` | `2048` | Max characters of the submitted destination. |\\n| `LINKS_CODE_LENGTH` | `7` | Base62 characters per generated code. |\\n| `LINKS_CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `5` | Retries on code collision before 503. |\\n| `LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX` | `20` | `POST /links` requests per IP per window. |\\n| `LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS` | `60` | Fixed window length in seconds. |\\n| `LINKS_TRUST_PROXY_HEADER` | `false` | Take client IP from last `X-Forwarded-For` entry. |\\n| `LINKS_DNS_TIMEOUT_MS` | `2000` | Per-host A/AAAA resolution timeout. |\\n| `LINKS_DNS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` | `0` | Resolution cache TTL; 0 disables caching. |\\n| `LINKS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_DESTINATIONS` | `false` | Test-only escape hatch; must stay false in production. |\\n| `LINKS_LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`. |\\n\\nThe service never issues an application-layer request to a user supplied\\ndestination: validation is limited to parsing and name resolution.\\n\"},{\"path\":\"main.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Root convenience entrypoint re-exporting the ASGI application.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nfrom app.main import app, create_app, run\\n\\n__all__ = [\\\"app\\\", \\\"create_app\\\", \\\"run\\\"]\\n\\n\\nif __name__ == \\\"__main__\\\": # pragma: no cover - process entrypoint\\n run()\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/__init__.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Public URL shortening service package.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\n__all__ = [\\\"__version__\\\"]\\n\\n__version__ = \\\"1.0.0\\\"\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/timeutil.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Timezone aware timestamp helpers shared by the service.\\n\\nAll timestamps handled by the service are aware UTC datetimes; the stored string\\nform is fixed width so lexicographic comparison equals chronological comparison.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\\n\\nISO_Z_FORMAT = \\\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef utc_now() -> datetime:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the current instant as an aware UTC datetime truncated to whole seconds.\\n\\n Returns:\\n An aware :class:`datetime` in UTC with ``microsecond`` set to 0 so that the\\n rendered ISO-8601 form is fixed width.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)\\n\\n\\ndef to_iso_z(moment: datetime) -> str:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Render an aware datetime as fixed width ISO-8601 UTC with a ``Z`` suffix.\\n\\n Args:\\n moment: An aware datetime in any timezone.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A string such as ``2024-01-31T10:20:30Z``.\\n\\n Raises:\\n ValueError: If ``moment`` is naive (no timezone information).\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if moment.tzinfo is None or moment.utcoffset() is None:\\n raise ValueError(\\\"naive datetimes are not supported\\\")\\n return moment.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime(ISO_Z_FORMAT)\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/config.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Environment driven configuration with safe defaults.\\n\\nEvery knob is read from the environment variable names given in the design; an\\nunparsable or out of range value falls back to the documented default and logs a\\nwarning rather than crashing the process.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport logging\\nimport os\\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\\nfrom typing import Dict, Final, Mapping, Optional\\nfrom urllib.parse import urlsplit\\n\\nLOGGER = logging.getLogger(\\\"links.config\\\")\\n\\nDEFAULTS: Final[Dict[str, str]] = {\\n \\\"LINKS_DB_PATH\\\": \\\"./links.db\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_BIND_HOST\\\": \\\"127.0.0.1\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_BIND_PORT\\\": \\\"8080\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL\\\": \\\"https://short.example.com\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_DEFAULT_EXPIRY_DAYS\\\": \\\"30\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_MAX_EXPIRY_DAYS\\\": \\\"365\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_MAX_URL_LENGTH\\\": \\\"2048\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_CODE_LENGTH\\\": \\\"7\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS\\\": \\\"5\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX\\\": \\\"20\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS\\\": \\\"60\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_TRUST_PROXY_HEADER\\\": \\\"false\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_DNS_TIMEOUT_MS\\\": \\\"2000\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_DNS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS\\\": \\\"0\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_DESTINATIONS\\\": \\\"false\\\",\\n \\\"LINKS_LOG_LEVEL\\\": \\\"info\\\",\\n}\\n\\n_LOG_LEVELS: Final[Dict[str, int]] = {\\n \\\"debug\\\": logging.DEBUG,\\n \\\"info\\\": logging.INFO,\\n \\\"warn\\\": logging.WARNING,\\n \\\"warning\\\": logging.WARNING,\\n \\\"error\\\": logging.ERROR,\\n}\\n\\n_UVICORN_LOG_LEVELS: Final[Dict[str, str]] = {\\n \\\"debug\\\": \\\"debug\\\",\\n \\\"info\\\": \\\"info\\\",\\n \\\"warn\\\": \\\"warning\\\",\\n \\\"warning\\\": \\\"warning\\\",\\n \\\"error\\\": \\\"error\\\",\\n}\\n\\n# Redirects are rate limited too, but far more generously than creation because a\\n# popular link is meant to be shared widely. Derived from LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX so\\n# that no configuration name outside the design's list is introduced.\\nREDIRECT_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER: Final[int] = 20\\n\\n\\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\\nclass Settings:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Immutable snapshot of the service configuration.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n db_path: str\\n bind_host: str\\n bind_port: int\\n public_base_url: str\\n default_expiry_days: int\\n max_expiry_days: int\\n max_url_length: int\\n code_length: int\\n code_max_attempts: int\\n rate_limit_max: int\\n rate_limit_window_seconds: int\\n trust_proxy_header: bool\\n dns_timeout_ms: int\\n dns_cache_ttl_seconds: int\\n allow_private_destinations: bool\\n log_level: str\\n\\n @property\\n def redirect_rate_limit_max(self) -> int:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the per-IP allowance for redirect requests inside one window.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The creation allowance multiplied by :data:`REDIRECT_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER`.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return max(self.rate_limit_max, self.rate_limit_max * REDIRECT_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER)\\n\\n @property\\n def uvicorn_log_level(self) -> str:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the configured log level translated to uvicorn's vocabulary.\\n\\n Returns:\\n One of ``debug``, ``info``, ``warning`` or ``error``.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return _UVICORN_LOG_LEVELS.get(self.log_level, \\\"info\\\")\\n\\n\\ndef _raw(env: Mapping[str, str], name: str) -> str:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the raw environment value for ``name`` or its documented default.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The configured string, never ``None``.\\n\\n Raises:\\n KeyError: If ``name`` is not a known configuration key.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n value = env.get(name)\\n if value is None or value.strip() == \\\"\\\":\\n return DEFAULTS[name]\\n return value\\n\\n\\ndef _read_bool(env: Mapping[str, str], name: str) -> bool:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Parse a boolean configuration value.\\n\\n Returns:\\n ``True`` only for ``1``, ``true``, ``yes`` or ``on`` (case insensitive).\\n\\n Raises:\\n KeyError: If ``name`` is not a known configuration key.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return _raw(env, name).strip().lower() in {\\\"1\\\", \\\"true\\\", \\\"yes\\\", \\\"on\\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef _read_int(env: Mapping[str, str], name: str, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> int:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Parse an integer configuration value, clamping to the documented default on error.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The parsed integer when it is within ``[minimum, maximum]``, otherwise the\\n documented default for ``name``.\\n\\n Raises:\\n KeyError: If ``name`` is not a known configuration key.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n raw = _raw(env, name)\\n try:\\n value = int(raw.strip())\\n except (TypeError, ValueError):\\n LOGGER.warning(\\\"invalid integer for %s; using default\\\", name)\\n return int(DEFAULTS[name])\\n if value < minimum or value > maximum:\\n LOGGER.warning(\\\"out of range value for %s; using default\\\", name)\\n return int(DEFAULTS[name])\\n return value\\n\\n\\ndef _read_public_base_url(env: Mapping[str, str]) -> str:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Read and normalise the public base URL used to build ``short_url`` values.\\n\\n Returns:\\n An origin without a trailing slash. Non http(s) values fall back to the default.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n raw = _raw(env, \\\"LINKS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL\\\").strip()\\n candidate = raw.rstrip(\\\"/\\\")\\n parts = urlsplit(candidate)\\n if parts.scheme not in {\\\"http\\\", \\\"https\\\"} or not parts.netloc:\\n LOGGER.warning(\\\"LINKS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL is not an http(s) origin; using default\\\")\\n return DEFAULTS[\\\"LINKS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL\\\"].rstrip(\\\"/\\\")\\n if parts.scheme != \\\"https\\\":\\n LOGGER.warning(\\\"LINKS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL is not https; the public API should be served over TLS\\\")\\n return candidate\\n\\n\\ndef load_settings(env: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None) -> Settings:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Build a :class:`Settings` snapshot from the process environment.\\n\\n Args:\\n env: Mapping to read from; defaults to :data:`os.environ`.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A frozen :class:`Settings` instance with safe defaults applied.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing; invalid values degrade to the documented defaults.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n source: Mapping[str, str] = os.environ if env is None else env\\n log_level = _raw(source, \\\"LINKS_LOG_LEVEL\\\").strip().lower()\\n if log_level not in _LOG_LEVELS:\\n log_level = DEFAULTS[\\\"LINKS_LOG_LEVEL\\\"]\\n\\n max_expiry_days = _read_int(source, \\\"LINKS_MAX_EXPIRY_DAYS\\\", 1, 36500)\\n default_expiry_days = _read_int(source, \\\"LINKS_DEFAULT_EXPIRY_DAYS\\\", 1, 36500)\\n if default_expiry_days > max_expiry_days:\\n LOGGER.warning(\\\"LINKS_DEFAULT_EXPIRY_DAYS exceeds LINKS_MAX_EXPIRY_DAYS; clamping\\\")\\n default_expiry_days = max_expiry_days\\n\\n return Settings(\\n db_path=_raw(source, \\\"LINKS_DB_PATH\\\").strip(),\\n bind_host=_raw(source, \\\"LINKS_BIND_HOST\\\").strip(),\\n bind_port=_read_int(source, \\\"LINKS_BIND_PORT\\\", 1, 65535),\\n public_base_url=_read_public_base_url(source),\\n default_expiry_days=default_expiry_days,\\n max_expiry_days=max_expiry_days,\\n max_url_length=_read_int(source, \\\"LINKS_MAX_URL_LENGTH\\\", 16, 65536),\\n code_length=_read_int(source, \\\"LINKS_CODE_LENGTH\\\", 4, 32),\\n code_max_attempts=_read_int(source, \\\"LINKS_CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS\\\", 1, 50),\\n rate_limit_max=_read_int(source, \\\"LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX\\\", 1, 1000000),\\n rate_limit_window_seconds=_read_int(source, \\\"LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS\\\", 1, 86400),\\n trust_proxy_header=_read_bool(source, \\\"LINKS_TRUST_PROXY_HEADER\\\"),\\n dns_timeout_ms=_read_int(source, \\\"LINKS_DNS_TIMEOUT_MS\\\", 10, 60000),\\n dns_cache_ttl_seconds=_read_int(source, \\\"LINKS_DNS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS\\\", 0, 86400),\\n allow_private_destinations=_read_bool(source, \\\"LINKS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_DESTINATIONS\\\"),\\n log_level=log_level,\\n )\\n\\n\\ndef configure_logging(settings: Settings) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Configure the root logger level from the settings snapshot.\\n\\n Args:\\n settings: The active configuration.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n level = _LOG_LEVELS.get(settings.log_level, logging.INFO)\\n logging.basicConfig(\\n level=level,\\n format=\\\"%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s\\\",\\n )\\n logging.getLogger(\\\"links\\\").setLevel(level)\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/errors.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Stable JSON error shape and exception handlers.\\n\\nEvery error response uses the same body shape and never carries a stack trace, a\\ndatabase message, a filesystem path or caller supplied markup.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport logging\\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Mapping, Optional\\n\\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\\nfrom fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError\\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse\\nfrom starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException\\n\\nLOGGER = logging.getLogger(\\\"links.errors\\\")\\n\\n_STATUS_CODE_NAMES: Dict[int, str] = {\\n 400: \\\"invalid_request\\\",\\n 404: \\\"not_found\\\",\\n 405: \\\"method_not_allowed\\\",\\n 410: \\\"link_expired\\\",\\n 413: \\\"payload_too_large\\\",\\n 415: \\\"unsupported_media_type\\\",\\n 422: \\\"invalid_request\\\",\\n 429: \\\"rate_limited\\\",\\n 500: \\\"internal_error\\\",\\n 502: \\\"destination_not_routable\\\",\\n 503: \\\"service_unavailable\\\",\\n}\\n\\n_STATUS_MESSAGES: Dict[int, str] = {\\n 400: \\\"The request could not be understood.\\\",\\n 404: \\\"No link exists for that code.\\\",\\n 405: \\\"That method is not allowed for this path.\\\",\\n 410: \\\"This link has expired.\\\",\\n 413: \\\"The request body is too large.\\\",\\n 415: \\\"The request media type is not supported.\\\",\\n 422: \\\"The request body is not valid.\\\",\\n 429: \\\"Too many requests; please retry later.\\\",\\n 500: \\\"An internal error occurred.\\\",\\n 502: \\\"The destination could not be served.\\\",\\n 503: \\\"The service is temporarily unavailable.\\\",\\n}\\n\\n\\nclass ApiError(Exception):\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Application level error carrying an HTTP status, a machine readable code and a safe message.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n def __init__(\\n self,\\n status_code: int,\\n code: str,\\n message: str,\\n headers: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None,\\n ) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Create an API error.\\n\\n Args:\\n status_code: HTTP status to return.\\n code: Stable machine readable error code.\\n message: Static, caller safe message (never echoes user input).\\n headers: Optional extra response headers, e.g. ``Retry-After``.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n super().__init__(message)\\n self.status_code = status_code\\n self.code = code\\n self.message = message\\n self.headers: Dict[str, str] = dict(headers) if headers else {}\\n\\n\\ndef error_payload(code: str, message: str) -> Dict[str, str]:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Build the canonical error body.\\n\\n Args:\\n code: Machine readable error code.\\n message: Static human readable message.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A dictionary with ``error``, ``code``, ``message`` and ``detail`` keys, all\\n of which are safe to show to any caller.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return {\\\"error\\\": code, \\\"code\\\": code, \\\"message\\\": message, \\\"detail\\\": message}\\n\\n\\ndef error_response(\\n status_code: int,\\n code: str,\\n message: str,\\n headers: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None,\\n) -> JSONResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Build a JSON error response using the canonical shape.\\n\\n Args:\\n status_code: HTTP status to return.\\n code: Machine readable error code.\\n message: Static human readable message.\\n headers: Optional extra headers merged into the response.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A :class:`JSONResponse` with ``Cache-Control: no-store``.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n final_headers: Dict[str, str] = {\\\"Cache-Control\\\": \\\"no-store\\\"}\\n if headers:\\n final_headers.update({str(key): str(value) for key, value in headers.items()})\\n return JSONResponse(status_code=status_code, content=error_payload(code, message), headers=final_headers)\\n\\n\\ndef register_exception_handlers(app: FastAPI) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Attach handlers that convert every failure into the canonical error shape.\\n\\n Args:\\n app: The FastAPI application to mutate.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n async def handle_api_error(_request: Request, exc: Exception) -> JSONResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Render an :class:`ApiError` as JSON.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The canonical error response for the raised error.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n error = exc if isinstance(exc, ApiError) else ApiError(500, \\\"internal_error\\\", _STATUS_MESSAGES[500])\\n return error_response(error.status_code, error.code, error.message, error.headers)\\n\\n async def handle_validation_error(_request: Request, _exc: Exception) -> JSONResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Render a request-model validation failure as a 400 without echoing input.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A 400 ``invalid_request`` response.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return error_response(400, \\\"invalid_request\\\", \\\"The request body is not valid.\\\")\\n\\n async def handle_http_exception(_request: Request, exc: Exception) -> JSONResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Render Starlette HTTP exceptions (404, 405, ...) in the canonical shape.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The canonical error response for the exception's status code.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n status = exc.status_code if isinstance(exc, StarletteHTTPException) else 500\\n headers: Dict[str, Any] = {}\\n if isinstance(exc, StarletteHTTPException) and exc.headers:\\n headers = {str(k): str(v) for k, v in exc.headers.items()}\\n code = _STATUS_CODE_NAMES.get(status, \\\"http_error\\\")\\n message = _STATUS_MESSAGES.get(status, \\\"The request could not be completed.\\\")\\n return error_response(status, code, message, headers)\\n\\n async def handle_unexpected_error(_request: Request, exc: Exception) -> JSONResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Render any unhandled exception as an opaque 500.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A 500 ``internal_error`` response with no internal detail.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n LOGGER.error(\\\"unhandled error of type %s\\\", type(exc).__name__)\\n return error_response(500, \\\"internal_error\\\", _STATUS_MESSAGES[500])\\n\\n app.add_exception_handler(ApiError, handle_api_error)\\n app.add_exception_handler(RequestValidationError, handle_validation_error)\\n app.add_exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException, handle_http_exception)\\n app.add_exception_handler(Exception, handle_unexpected_error)\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/codes.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Cryptographically secure short code generation.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport secrets\\nimport string\\nfrom typing import Final, FrozenSet\\n\\nCODE_ALPHABET: Final[str] = string.digits + string.ascii_uppercase + string.ascii_lowercase\\nCODE_ALPHABET_SET: Final[FrozenSet[str]] = frozenset(CODE_ALPHABET)\\nDEFAULT_CODE_LENGTH: Final[int] = 7\\nMAX_CODE_LENGTH: Final[int] = 64\\n\\n\\ndef generate_code(length: int = DEFAULT_CODE_LENGTH) -> str:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Generate a base62 short code from a cryptographically secure random source.\\n\\n Args:\\n length: Number of base62 characters to emit.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A random, non sequential, non enumerable code of exactly ``length`` characters.\\n\\n Raises:\\n ValueError: If ``length`` is outside ``[1, MAX_CODE_LENGTH]``.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if length < 1 or length > MAX_CODE_LENGTH:\\n raise ValueError(\\\"code length out of range\\\")\\n return \\\"\\\".join(secrets.choice(CODE_ALPHABET) for _ in range(length))\\n\\n\\ndef is_plausible_code(code: str, max_length: int = MAX_CODE_LENGTH) -> bool:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Report whether a path segment could be a short code at all.\\n\\n Args:\\n code: The candidate path segment supplied by the caller.\\n max_length: Longest accepted candidate length.\\n\\n Returns:\\n ``True`` when the candidate is non empty, within the length bound and made\\n solely of base62 characters; ``False`` otherwise, in which case the caller\\n must answer 404 without querying the datastore.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if not code or len(code) > max_length:\\n return False\\n return all(character in CODE_ALPHABET_SET for character in code)\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/models.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Typed request and response models validated at the HTTP boundary.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nfrom typing import Optional\\n\\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, StrictInt, StrictStr\\n\\n# Hard boundary cap on the accepted body string. The configured\\n# LINKS_MAX_URL_LENGTH is enforced separately so that an over long URL yields the\\n# machine readable ``url_too_long`` code rather than a generic body rejection.\\nMAX_ACCEPTED_URL_CHARS = 65536\\n\\n\\nclass CreateLinkRequest(BaseModel):\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Body of ``POST /links``.\\n\\n Unknown fields are rejected rather than ignored, and values are validated in\\n strict mode so that e.g. ``\\\"7\\\"`` or ``true`` are not coerced into an integer.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n model_config = ConfigDict(extra=\\\"forbid\\\")\\n\\n url: StrictStr = Field(\\n ...,\\n min_length=1,\\n max_length=MAX_ACCEPTED_URL_CHARS,\\n description=\\\"Absolute http or https destination URL to shorten.\\\",\\n )\\n expires_in_days: Optional[StrictInt] = Field(\\n default=None,\\n description=\\\"Lifetime in whole days; omitted means the configured default.\\\",\\n )\\n\\n\\nclass CreateLinkResponse(BaseModel):\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Body returned by a successful ``POST /links``.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n model_config = ConfigDict(extra=\\\"forbid\\\")\\n\\n code: str = Field(..., description=\\\"The issued base62 short code.\\\")\\n short_url: str = Field(..., description=\\\"Full short URL built from the public base URL.\\\")\\n destination: str = Field(..., description=\\\"The normalized destination that will be served.\\\")\\n created_at: str = Field(..., description=\\\"ISO-8601 UTC creation timestamp.\\\")\\n expires_at: str = Field(..., description=\\\"ISO-8601 UTC expiry timestamp.\\\")\\n\\n\\nclass HealthResponse(BaseModel):\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Body returned by the liveness endpoint.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n model_config = ConfigDict(extra=\\\"forbid\\\")\\n\\n status: str = Field(..., description=\\\"Always 'ok' when the process is live.\\\")\\n service: str = Field(..., description=\\\"Service identifier.\\\")\\n time: str = Field(..., description=\\\"Current ISO-8601 UTC time.\\\")\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/ratelimit.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"In-process fixed window rate limiting.\\n\\nThe limiter is a per-node hash map of ``scope:client_ip`` to a window counter. It\\nis intentionally not persisted: it must not add a write to the hot creation path.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport math\\nimport threading\\nimport time\\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\\nfrom typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple\\n\\n_MAX_TRACKED_KEYS = 100000\\n\\n\\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\\nclass RateLimitDecision:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Outcome of a rate limit check.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n allowed: bool\\n retry_after: int\\n remaining: int\\n\\n\\nclass FixedWindowRateLimiter:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Thread safe fixed window counter keyed by an opaque string.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n def __init__(self, window_seconds: int) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Create a limiter.\\n\\n Args:\\n window_seconds: Length of the fixed window; values below 1 are clamped to 1.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n self._window = max(1, int(window_seconds))\\n self._buckets: Dict[str, Tuple[int, int]] = {}\\n self._lock = threading.Lock()\\n self._last_sweep = 0.0\\n\\n @property\\n def window_seconds(self) -> int:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the configured window length in seconds.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The window length used for bucketing and for ``Retry-After``.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return self._window\\n\\n def check(self, key: str, limit: int, now: Optional[float] = None) -> RateLimitDecision:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Count one request against ``key`` and decide whether it may proceed.\\n\\n Args:\\n key: Opaque bucket key, e.g. ``\\\"create:198.51.100.7\\\"``.\\n limit: Maximum requests allowed inside the current window.\\n now: Unix seconds; defaults to the current wall clock.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A :class:`RateLimitDecision`; when ``allowed`` is ``False`` the\\n ``retry_after`` field holds the whole seconds remaining in the window\\n (minimum 1).\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n moment = time.time() if now is None else now\\n window_start = int(moment // self._window) * self._window\\n retry_after = max(1, int(math.ceil(window_start + self._window - moment)))\\n effective_limit = max(0, int(limit))\\n\\n with self._lock:\\n self._sweep_locked(window_start, moment)\\n bucket = self._buckets.get(key)\\n count = bucket[1] + 1 if bucket is not None and bucket[0] == window_start else 1\\n if count > effective_limit:\\n self._buckets[key] = (window_start, effective_limit + 1)\\n return RateLimitDecision(allowed=False, retry_after=retry_after, remaining=0)\\n self._buckets[key] = (window_start, count)\\n return RateLimitDecision(\\n allowed=True,\\n retry_after=retry_after,\\n remaining=max(0, effective_limit - count),\\n )\\n\\n def reset(self) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Drop all counters.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n with self._lock:\\n self._buckets.clear()\\n self._last_sweep = 0.0\\n\\n def _sweep_locked(self, window_start: int, moment: float) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Evict buckets belonging to elapsed windows; caller must hold the lock.\\n\\n Args:\\n window_start: Start epoch of the current window.\\n moment: Current unix seconds.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if moment - self._last_sweep < self._window and len(self._buckets) < _MAX_TRACKED_KEYS:\\n return\\n self._last_sweep = moment\\n stale = [key for key, value in self._buckets.items() if value[0] != window_start]\\n for key in stale:\\n self._buckets.pop(key, None)\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/validation.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Destination URL parsing, normalization and SSRF validation.\\n\\nValidation is limited to parsing and name resolution: the service never opens a\\nsocket to a user supplied destination host or port, at creation or at redirect\\ntime.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport ipaddress\\nimport logging\\nimport re\\nimport socket\\nimport time\\nfrom concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor\\nfrom concurrent.futures import TimeoutError as FutureTimeoutError\\nfrom threading import Lock\\nfrom typing import Dict, Final, FrozenSet, List, Optional, Tuple, Union\\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, urlsplit, urlunsplit\\n\\nimport idna\\n\\nfrom .config import Settings\\n\\nLOGGER = logging.getLogger(\\\"links.validation\\\")\\n\\nIPAddress = Union[ipaddress.IPv4Address, ipaddress.IPv6Address]\\n\\nALLOWED_SCHEMES: Final[FrozenSet[str]] = frozenset({\\\"http\\\", \\\"https\\\"})\\nDEFAULT_PORTS: Final[Dict[str, int]] = {\\\"http\\\": 80, \\\"https\\\": 443}\\n\\n_PATH_SAFE: Final[str] = \\\"/%:@!$&'()*+,;=~-._\\\"\\n_QUERY_SAFE: Final[str] = \\\"/%:@!$&'()*+,;=?~-._\\\"\\n_FRAGMENT_SAFE: Final[str] = \\\"/%:@!$&'()*+,;=?~-._\\\"\\n\\n_ASCII_HOST_RE: Final[re.Pattern[str]] = re.compile(\\n r\\\"^(?=.{1,253}$)[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?\\\"\\n r\\\"(\\\\.[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)*$\\\"\\n)\\n\\n_DENIED_IPV4_NETWORKS: Final[Tuple[ipaddress.IPv4Network, ...]] = tuple(\\n ipaddress.ip_network(cidr)\\n for cidr in (\\n \\\"0.0.0.0/8\\\",\\n \\\"10.0.0.0/8\\\",\\n \\\"100.64.0.0/10\\\",\\n \\\"127.0.0.0/8\\\",\\n \\\"169.254.0.0/16\\\",\\n \\\"172.16.0.0/12\\\",\\n \\\"192.0.0.0/24\\\",\\n \\\"192.0.2.0/24\\\",\\n \\\"192.31.196.0/24\\\",\\n \\\"192.52.193.0/24\\\",\\n \\\"192.88.99.0/24\\\",\\n \\\"192.168.0.0/16\\\",\\n \\\"198.18.0.0/15\\\",\\n \\\"198.51.100.0/24\\\",\\n \\\"203.0.113.0/24\\\",\\n \\\"224.0.0.0/4\\\",\\n \\\"240.0.0.0/4\\\",\\n \\\"255.255.255.255/32\\\",\\n )\\n)\\n\\n_DENIED_IPV6_NETWORKS: Final[Tuple[ipaddress.IPv6Network, ...]] = tuple(\\n ipaddress.ip_network(cidr)\\n for cidr in (\\n \\\"::/128\\\",\\n \\\"::1/128\\\",\\n \\\"::ffff:0:0/96\\\",\\n \\\"64:ff9b::/96\\\",\\n \\\"64:ff9b:1::/48\\\",\\n \\\"100::/64\\\",\\n \\\"2001::/32\\\",\\n \\\"2001:2::/48\\\",\\n \\\"2001:db8::/32\\\",\\n \\\"2002::/16\\\",\\n \\\"fc00::/7\\\",\\n \\\"fe80::/10\\\",\\n \\\"ff00::/8\\\",\\n )\\n)\\n\\n# Cloud metadata endpoints are denied explicitly: reaching one is how a URL\\n# fetcher turns into a credential leak.\\n_EXPLICIT_DENIED_ADDRESSES: Final[FrozenSet[IPAddress]] = frozenset(\\n {\\n ipaddress.ip_address(\\\"169.254.169.254\\\"),\\n ipaddress.ip_address(\\\"169.254.170.2\\\"),\\n ipaddress.ip_address(\\\"fd00:ec2::254\\\"),\\n }\\n)\\n\\n\\nclass DestinationError(Exception):\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Raised when a destination URL is malformed, disallowed or not routable.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n def __init__(self, code: str, message: str) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Create a destination validation error.\\n\\n Args:\\n code: Machine readable error code such as ``scheme_not_allowed``.\\n message: Static message; it never echoes the submitted URL or a resolved IP.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n super().__init__(message)\\n self.code = code\\n self.message = message\\n\\n\\ndef is_denied_address(address: IPAddress) -> bool:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Report whether an IP address is in a range the service refuses to reach.\\n\\n Loopback, private, carrier grade NAT, link local (including the cloud metadata\\n addresses), unique local, multicast, reserved and unspecified ranges are all\\n denied, as are IPv6 forms that embed such an IPv4 address.\\n\\n Args:\\n address: The address to test.\\n\\n Returns:\\n ``True`` when the address must not be used as a destination.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if address in _EXPLICIT_DENIED_ADDRESSES:\\n return True\\n if isinstance(address, ipaddress.IPv6Address):\\n embedded: List[ipaddress.IPv4Address] = []\\n if address.ipv4_mapped is not None:\\n embedded.append(address.ipv4_mapped)\\n if address.sixtofour is not None:\\n embedded.append(address.sixtofour)\\n teredo = address.teredo\\n if teredo is not None:\\n embedded.extend([teredo[0], teredo[1]])\\n for candidate in embedded:\\n if is_denied_address(candidate):\\n return True\\n if (\\n address.is_loopback\\n or address.is_private\\n or address.is_link_local\\n or address.is_multicast\\n or address.is_reserved\\n or address.is_unspecified\\n ):\\n return True\\n if not address.is_global:\\n return True\\n networks = _DENIED_IPV4_NETWORKS if address.version == 4 else _DENIED_IPV6_NETWORKS\\n return any(address in network for network in networks)\\n\\n\\ndef _encode_host(host: str) -> str:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Normalise a hostname to a lowercase ASCII (punycode A-label) form.\\n\\n Args:\\n host: The host component as parsed from the URL.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The IDNA A-label form of the host, lowercased and without a trailing dot.\\n\\n Raises:\\n DestinationError: If the host is not a usable domain name.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n candidate = host.strip()\\n while candidate.endswith(\\\".\\\"):\\n candidate = candidate[:-1]\\n if not candidate:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL must include a host.\\\")\\n try:\\n return idna.encode(candidate, uts46=True, transitional=False).decode(\\\"ascii\\\").lower()\\n except (idna.IDNAError, UnicodeError, ValueError):\\n if _ASCII_HOST_RE.match(candidate):\\n return candidate.lower()\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination host is not a valid domain name.\\\")\\n\\n\\ndef normalize_destination(raw_url: str, settings: Settings) -> Tuple[str, str]:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Parse and normalise a caller supplied destination URL.\\n\\n The returned URL is what gets stored and later served, so nothing that skipped\\n this function can ever be reached through a short link.\\n\\n Args:\\n raw_url: The raw string supplied by the caller.\\n settings: Active configuration (supplies the maximum URL length).\\n\\n Returns:\\n A tuple ``(normalized_url, host)`` where ``host`` is the ASCII host to\\n resolve (an IP literal is returned in canonical form).\\n\\n Raises:\\n DestinationError: If the URL is too long, malformed, carries credentials or\\n uses a scheme other than http/https.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if len(raw_url) > settings.max_url_length:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"url_too_long\\\", \\\"The destination URL is longer than the allowed maximum.\\\")\\n for character in raw_url:\\n if character.isspace() or ord(character) < 0x20 or ord(character) == 0x7F:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL contains whitespace or control characters.\\\")\\n\\n try:\\n parts = urlsplit(raw_url)\\n except ValueError:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL could not be parsed.\\\")\\n\\n scheme = parts.scheme.lower()\\n if not scheme:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL must be absolute and include a scheme.\\\")\\n if scheme not in ALLOWED_SCHEMES:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"scheme_not_allowed\\\", \\\"Only http and https destinations are allowed.\\\")\\n\\n netloc = parts.netloc\\n if not netloc:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL must include a host.\\\")\\n if \\\"@\\\" in netloc:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"credentials_in_url\\\", \\\"Embedded credentials are not allowed in a destination URL.\\\")\\n\\n try:\\n port = parts.port\\n except ValueError:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL has an invalid port.\\\")\\n if port is not None and not 1 <= port <= 65535:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL has an invalid port.\\\")\\n\\n host_raw = parts.hostname\\n if not host_raw:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL must include a host.\\\")\\n\\n literal: Optional[IPAddress]\\n try:\\n literal = ipaddress.ip_address(host_raw)\\n except ValueError:\\n literal = None\\n\\n if netloc.startswith(\\\"[\\\") and (literal is None or literal.version != 6):\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL has an invalid IPv6 host.\\\")\\n\\n if literal is not None:\\n host = str(literal)\\n netloc_host = \\\"[{0}]\\\".format(host) if literal.version == 6 else host\\n else:\\n host = _encode_host(host_raw)\\n netloc_host = host\\n\\n if port is not None and port != DEFAULT_PORTS[scheme]:\\n normalized_netloc = \\\"{0}:{1}\\\".format(netloc_host, port)\\n else:\\n normalized_netloc = netloc_host\\n\\n path = quote(parts.path, safe=_PATH_SAFE)\\n query = quote(parts.query, safe=_QUERY_SAFE)\\n fragment = quote(parts.fragment, safe=_FRAGMENT_SAFE)\\n normalized = urlunsplit((scheme, normalized_netloc, path, query, fragment))\\n\\n try:\\n normalized.encode(\\\"ascii\\\")\\n except UnicodeEncodeError:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL could not be normalized.\\\")\\n\\n if len(normalized) > settings.max_url_length:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"url_too_long\\\", \\\"The destination URL is longer than the allowed maximum.\\\")\\n return normalized, host\\n\\n\\ndef host_of(url: str) -> Optional[str]:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Extract the host from an already normalised URL.\\n\\n Args:\\n url: A stored, normalised absolute URL.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The lowercase host, or ``None`` when the URL has no host.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n try:\\n parsed = urlsplit(url)\\n except ValueError:\\n return None\\n return parsed.hostname\\n\\n\\nclass DestinationValidator:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Resolves destination hosts and rejects any that map to non routable space.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n def __init__(self, settings: Settings) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Create a validator bound to the active settings.\\n\\n Args:\\n settings: Active configuration (DNS timeout, cache TTL, escape hatch).\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n self._settings = settings\\n self._cache: Dict[str, Tuple[float, Tuple[str, ...]]] = {}\\n self._lock = Lock()\\n self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8, thread_name_prefix=\\\"dns\\\")\\n\\n def close(self) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Shut down the resolver thread pool.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n self._executor.shutdown(wait=False)\\n\\n def assert_routable(self, host: str) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Reject a host that is, or resolves to, a non routable address.\\n\\n Args:\\n host: ASCII host (domain name or IP literal) taken from a normalised URL.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None when every resolved address is publicly routable.\\n\\n Raises:\\n DestinationError: With code ``destination_not_routable`` when any\\n resolved address is denied, or ``destination_unresolvable`` when the\\n host cannot be resolved within the configured timeout.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if self._settings.allow_private_destinations:\\n LOGGER.debug(\\\"destination range checks disabled by configuration\\\")\\n return\\n if not host:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"invalid_url\\\", \\\"The destination URL must include a host.\\\")\\n\\n try:\\n literal = ipaddress.ip_address(host)\\n except ValueError:\\n literal = None\\n\\n if literal is not None:\\n if is_denied_address(literal):\\n raise DestinationError(\\n \\\"destination_not_routable\\\",\\n \\\"The destination host is not a publicly routable address.\\\",\\n )\\n return\\n\\n addresses = self.resolve(host)\\n for text in addresses:\\n try:\\n resolved = ipaddress.ip_address(text)\\n except ValueError:\\n raise DestinationError(\\n \\\"destination_not_routable\\\",\\n \\\"The destination host is not a publicly routable address.\\\",\\n )\\n if is_denied_address(resolved):\\n raise DestinationError(\\n \\\"destination_not_routable\\\",\\n \\\"The destination host is not a publicly routable address.\\\",\\n )\\n\\n def resolve(self, host: str) -> Tuple[str, ...]:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Resolve A and AAAA records for a host with a bounded timeout.\\n\\n Args:\\n host: ASCII domain name.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A non empty tuple of textual IP addresses.\\n\\n Raises:\\n DestinationError: With code ``destination_unresolvable`` on NXDOMAIN,\\n resolver error, empty answer or timeout.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n ttl = self._settings.dns_cache_ttl_seconds\\n now = time.monotonic()\\n if ttl > 0:\\n with self._lock:\\n cached = self._cache.get(host)\\n if cached is not None and cached[0] > now:\\n return cached[1]\\n\\n future = self._executor.submit(\\n socket.getaddrinfo, host, None, socket.AF_UNSPEC, socket.SOCK_STREAM\\n )\\n try:\\n infos = future.result(timeout=self._settings.dns_timeout_ms / 1000.0)\\n except FutureTimeoutError:\\n future.cancel()\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"destination_unresolvable\\\", \\\"The destination host could not be resolved.\\\")\\n except (socket.gaierror, UnicodeError, OSError, ValueError):\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"destination_unresolvable\\\", \\\"The destination host could not be resolved.\\\")\\n\\n addresses = tuple(\\n sorted({str(info[4][0]).split(\\\"%\\\")[0] for info in infos if info and info[4]})\\n )\\n if not addresses:\\n raise DestinationError(\\\"destination_unresolvable\\\", \\\"The destination host could not be resolved.\\\")\\n\\n if ttl > 0:\\n with self._lock:\\n if len(self._cache) > 10000:\\n self._cache.clear()\\n self._cache[host] = (now + ttl, addresses)\\n return addresses\\n\"},{\"path\":\"app/db.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"SQLite persistence for issued short links.\\n\\nAll statements are parameterized; no SQL is ever built by string formatting.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport logging\\nimport os\\nimport sqlite3\\nimport threading\\nimport time\\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\\nfrom datetime import timedelta\\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Iterator, Optional, Tuple\\n\\nfrom .timeutil import to_iso_z, utc_now\\n\\nLOGGER = logging.getLogger(\\\"links.db\\\")\\n\\n_SCHEMA_STATEMENTS: Tuple[str, ...] = (\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS links (\\n id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\\n code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\\n destination TEXT NOT NULL,\\n created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\\n expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,\\n creator_ip TEXT NOT NULL,\\n click_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\\n last_clicked_at TEXT\\n )\\n \\\"\\\"\\\",\\n \\\"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_links_expires_at ON links (expires_at)\\\",\\n)\\n\\n\\nclass Database:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Thin, thread safe wrapper around the links SQLite database.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n def __init__(self, path: str) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Open (or prepare to open) the database at ``path``.\\n\\n Args:\\n path: Filesystem path, or ``:memory:`` for an ephemeral database that\\n lives in a single shared, lock protected connection.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n sqlite3.Error: If an in-memory connection cannot be created.\\n OSError: If the parent directory of a file database cannot be created.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n self._path = path.strip() or \\\":memory:\\\"\\n self._memory = self._path == \\\":memory:\\\"\\n self._lock = threading.RLock()\\n self._shared: Optional[sqlite3.Connection] = None\\n if self._memory:\\n self._shared = self._open()\\n else:\\n parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self._path))\\n if parent:\\n os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)\\n\\n @property\\n def path(self) -> str:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the configured database path.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The path string, ``:memory:`` for ephemeral databases.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return self._path\\n\\n def _open(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Create a configured SQLite connection.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A connection in autocommit mode with WAL, NORMAL sync and a busy timeout.\\n\\n Raises:\\n sqlite3.Error: If the connection cannot be established.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n connection = sqlite3.connect(\\n self._path,\\n timeout=5.0,\\n check_same_thread=False,\\n isolation_level=None,\\n )\\n connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\\n try:\\n if not self._memory:\\n connection.execute(\\\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL\\\")\\n connection.execute(\\\"PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL\\\")\\n connection.execute(\\\"PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000\\\")\\n connection.execute(\\\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON\\\")\\n except sqlite3.Error:\\n LOGGER.warning(\\\"could not apply all SQLite pragmas\\\")\\n return connection\\n\\n @contextmanager\\n def connection(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Yield a connection, shared for in-memory mode and per call for file mode.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A context manager yielding a :class:`sqlite3.Connection`.\\n\\n Raises:\\n sqlite3.Error: If a new connection cannot be opened.\\n RuntimeError: If the shared in-memory connection is missing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if self._memory:\\n if self._shared is None:\\n raise RuntimeError(\\\"in-memory database is not initialised\\\")\\n with self._lock:\\n yield self._shared\\n return\\n connection = self._open()\\n try:\\n yield connection\\n finally:\\n connection.close()\\n\\n def initialize(self) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Create the schema and indexes when they do not yet exist.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n sqlite3.Error: If the schema cannot be created.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n with self.connection() as connection:\\n for statement in _SCHEMA_STATEMENTS:\\n connection.execute(statement)\\n\\n def insert_link(\\n self,\\n code: str,\\n destination: str,\\n created_at: str,\\n expires_at: str,\\n creator_ip: str,\\n ) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Insert one link row.\\n\\n Args:\\n code: The generated base62 short code.\\n destination: The normalised absolute destination URL.\\n created_at: ISO-8601 UTC creation timestamp.\\n expires_at: ISO-8601 UTC expiry timestamp.\\n creator_ip: Client IP recorded for abuse triage; never returned.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n sqlite3.IntegrityError: If the code collides with an existing row.\\n sqlite3.Error: On any other datastore failure.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n with self.connection() as connection:\\n connection.execute(\\n \\\"INSERT INTO links (code, destination, created_at, expires_at, creator_ip, \\\"\\n \\\"click_count, last_clicked_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, NULL)\\\",\\n (code, destination, created_at, expires_at, creator_ip),\\n )\\n\\n def get_link(self, code: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Look up a link by its code.\\n\\n Args:\\n code: The short code from the request path.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A dictionary with ``code``, ``destination`` and ``expires_at``, or\\n ``None`` when no such row exists.\\n\\n Raises:\\n sqlite3.Error: On a datastore failure.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n with self.connection() as connection:\\n cursor = connection.execute(\\n \\\"SELECT code, destination, expires_at FROM links WHERE code = ?\\\",\\n (code,),\\n )\\n row = cursor.fetchone()\\n if row is None:\\n return None\\n return {\\n \\\"code\\\": row[\\\"code\\\"],\\n \\\"destination\\\": row[\\\"destination\\\"],\\n \\\"expires_at\\\": row[\\\"expires_at\\\"],\\n }\\n\\n def record_click(self, code: str, clicked_at: str) -> bool:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Increment best effort click analytics for a code.\\n\\n Args:\\n code: The short code that was resolved.\\n clicked_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the redirect.\\n\\n Returns:\\n ``True`` when a row was updated.\\n\\n Raises:\\n sqlite3.Error: On a datastore failure.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n with self.connection() as connection:\\n cursor = connection.execute(\\n \\\"UPDATE links SET click_count = click_count + 1, last_clicked_at = ? WHERE code = ?\\\",\\n (clicked_at, code),\\n )\\n return cursor.rowcount > 0\\n\\n def delete_expired(self, cutoff: str) -> int:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Delete rows whose expiry is at or before ``cutoff``.\\n\\n Args:\\n cutoff: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp; rows expiring at or before it are removed.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The number of deleted rows.\\n\\n Raises:\\n sqlite3.Error: On a datastore failure.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n with self.connection() as connection:\\n cursor = connection.execute(\\\"DELETE FROM links WHERE expires_at <= ?\\\", (cutoff,))\\n return int(cursor.rowcount or 0)\\n\\n\\nclass ExpiryPurger:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Rate limited housekeeping that removes long expired rows.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n def __init__(self, database: Database, interval_seconds: int = 300, grace_days: int = 30) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Create a purger.\\n\\n Args:\\n database: The database to clean.\\n interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between two purges.\\n grace_days: Rows keep serving 410 for this long after expiry before deletion.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n self._database = database\\n self._interval = max(1, interval_seconds)\\n self._grace_days = max(0, grace_days)\\n self._lock = threading.Lock()\\n self._last_run: Optional[float] = None\\n\\n def maybe_purge(self) -> int:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Purge long expired rows if the interval has elapsed.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The number of deleted rows (0 when the purge was skipped or failed).\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing; datastore failures are logged and swallowed.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n now = time.monotonic()\\n with self._lock:\\n if self._last_run is not None and now - self._last_run < self._interval:\\n return 0\\n self._last_run = now\\n cutoff = to_iso_z(utc_now() - timedelta(days=self._grace_days))\\n try:\\n deleted = self._database.delete_expired(cutoff)\\n except sqlite3.Error:\\n LOGGER.warning(\\\"expired link purge failed\\\")\\n return 0\\n if deleted:\\n service.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport logging\\nimport sqlite3\\nfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\\nfrom datetime import timedelta\\nfrom typing import AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable, FrozenSet, Optional, Tuple\\n\\nfrom fastapi import BackgroundTasks, FastAPI, Request, Response\\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse\\n\\nfrom .codes import generate_code, is_plausible_code\\nfrom .config import Settings, configure_logging, load_settings\\nfrom .db import Database, ExpiryPurger\\nfrom .errors import ApiError, error_response, register_exception_handlers\\nfrom .models import CreateLinkResponse, CreateLinkRequest, HealthResponse\\nfrom .ratelimit import FixedWindowRateLimiter\\nfrom .timeutil import to_iso_z, utc_now\\nfrom .validation import DestinationError, DestinationValidator, host_of, normalize_destination\\n\\nLOGGER = logging.getLogger(\\\"links\\\")\\n\\n# Single segment paths that are owned by the service and therefore never treated\\n# as a short code for rate limiting purposes.\\nRESERVED_PATHS: FrozenSet[str] = frozenset(\\n {\\\"links\\\", \\\"health\\\", \\\"healthz\\\", \\\"livez\\\", \\\"readyz\\\", \\\"docs\\\", \\\"redoc\\\", \\\"openapi.json\\\", \\\"favicon.ico\\\"}\\n)\\n\\n\\ndef client_ip_for(request: Request, settings: Settings) -> str:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Determine the rate limiting identity of the caller.\\n\\n Args:\\n request: The incoming request.\\n settings: Active configuration; ``trust_proxy_header`` decides whether the\\n last ``X-Forwarded-For`` entry may be used.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A short string identifying the client; the socket peer address unless the\\n deployment explicitly trusts a fronting proxy.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n peer = request.client.host if request.client is not None else \\\"unknown\\\"\\n if settings.trust_proxy_header:\\n header = request.headers.get(\\\"x-forwarded-for\\\", \\\"\\\")\\n entries = [entry.strip() for entry in header.split(\\\",\\\") if entry.strip()]\\n if entries:\\n return entries[-1][:64]\\n return (peer or \\\"unknown\\\")[:64]\\n\\n\\ndef _rate_limit_scope(request: Request, settings: Settings) -> Optional[Tuple[str, int]]:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Decide which rate limit bucket, if any, applies to a request.\\n\\n Args:\\n request: The incoming request.\\n settings: Active configuration supplying the allowances.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A ``(scope_name, limit)`` tuple, or ``None`` when the path is not rate\\n limited (health checks and documentation).\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n segments = [segment for segment in request.url.path.split(\\\"/\\\") if segment]\\n if request.method == \\\"POST\\\" and len(segments) == 1 and segments[0] == \\\"links\\\":\\n return (\\\"create\\\", settings.rate_limit_max)\\n if (\\n request.method in {\\\"GET\\\", \\\"HEAD\\\"}\\n and len(segments) == 1\\n and segments[0].lower() not in RESERVED_PATHS\\n ):\\n return (\\\"redirect\\\", settings.redirect_rate_limit_max)\\n return None\\n\\n\\ndef _record_click(database: Database, code: str) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Update best effort click analytics after a redirect has been written.\\n\\n Args:\\n database: The datastore.\\n code: The resolved short code.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing; datastore failures are logged and never break a working link.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n try:\\n database.record_click(code, to_iso_z(utc_now()))\\n except sqlite3.Error:\\n LOGGER.warning(\\\"click analytics update failed\\\")\\n\\n\\ndef _run_purge(purger: ExpiryPurger) -> None:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Run the rate limited expired-link purge in the background.\\n\\n Args:\\n purger: The housekeeping helper.\\n\\n Returns:\\n None.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n purger.maybe_purge()\\n\\n\\ndef create_app(settings: Optional[Settings] = None) -> FastAPI:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Build and wire the FastAPI application.\\n\\n Args:\\n settings: Optional pre-built configuration; loaded from the environment when omitted.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A configured :class:`FastAPI` instance with routes, middleware and error handlers.\\n\\n Raises:\\n sqlite3.Error: If the database schema cannot be created at startup.\\n OSError: If the database directory cannot be created.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n active = settings if settings is not None else load_settings()\\n configure_logging(active)\\n\\n database = Database(active.db_path)\\n database.initialize()\\n limiter = FixedWindowRateLimiter(active.rate_limit_window_seconds)\\n validator = DestinationValidator(active)\\n purger = ExpiryPurger(database)\\n\\n @asynccontextmanager\\n async def lifespan(_app: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Manage process scoped resources.\\n\\n Returns:\\n An async context manager that releases the resolver pool on shutdown.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n LOGGER.info(\\\"url shortener starting\\\")\\n try:\\n yield\\n finally:\\n validator.close()\\n LOGGER.info(\\\"url shortener stopped\\\")\\n\\n app = FastAPI(\\n title=\\\"URL Shortener\\\",\\n version=\\\"1.0.0\\\",\\n description=\\\"Issues short redirect links to validated public http(s) destinations.\\\",\\n lifespan=lifespan,\\n )\\n # Never emit a redirect whose Location is derived from the incoming path.\\n app.router.redirect_slashes = False\\n\\n app.state.settings = active\\n app.state.db = database\\n app.state.rate_limiter = limiter\\n app.state.validator = validator\\n app.state.purger = purger\\n\\n register_exception_handlers(app)\\n\\n @app.middleware(\\\"http\\\")\\n async def rate_limit_middleware(\\n request: Request, call_next: Callable[[Request], Awaitable[Response]]\\n ) -> Response:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Enforce per-IP rate limits for creation and redirects in one place.\\n\\n Args:\\n request: The incoming request.\\n call_next: The downstream ASGI handler.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The downstream response, or a 429 JSON error carrying ``Retry-After``\\n when the caller exceeded the allowance for the scope. The limiter runs\\n before body parsing, validation, DNS and any insert.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing directly; downstream exceptions reach the registered handlers.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n scope = _rate_limit_scope(request, active)\\n if scope is not None:\\n name, limit = scope\\n key = \\\"{0}:{1}\\\".format(name, client_ip_for(request, active))\\n decision = limiter.check(key, limit)\\n if not decision.allowed:\\n return error_response(\\n 429,\\n \\\"rate_limited\\\",\\n \\\"Too many requests; please retry later.\\\",\\n {\\\"Retry-After\\\": str(decision.retry_after)},\\n )\\n return await call_next(request)\\n\\n def _health_body() -> HealthResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Build the liveness payload without touching user data.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A :class:`HealthResponse` describing process liveness.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n return HealthResponse(status=\\\"ok\\\", service=\\\"links\\\", time=to_iso_z(utc_now()))\\n\\n @app.get(\\\"/healthz\\\", response_model=HealthResponse, tags=[\\\"ops\\\"])\\n def healthz(response: Response) -> HealthResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Report process liveness.\\n\\n Args:\\n response: Injected response used to set cache headers.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A payload with ``status``, ``service`` and the current UTC time. No user\\n data or datastore is touched.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n response.headers[\\\"Cache-Control\\\"] = \\\"no-store\\\"\\n return _health_body()\\n\\n @app.get(\\\"/health\\\", response_model=HealthResponse, tags=[\\\"ops\\\"])\\n def health(response: Response) -> HealthResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Alias of :func:`healthz` for deployments that probe ``/health``.\\n\\n Args:\\n response: Injected response used to set cache headers.\\n\\n Returns:\\n The same liveness payload as ``/healthz``.\\n\\n Raises:\\n Nothing.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n response.headers[\\\"Cache-Control\\\"] = \\\"no-store\\\"\\n return _health_body()\\n\\n @app.post(\\\"/links\\\", response_model=CreateLinkResponse, status_code=201, tags=[\\\"links\\\"])\\n def create_link(\\n payload: CreateLinkRequest,\\n request: Request,\\n response: Response,\\n background: BackgroundTasks,\\n ) -> CreateLinkResponse:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Create a short link for a validated public http(s) destination.\\n\\n Args:\\n payload: Validated request body.\\n request: The incoming request (used for the creator IP only).\\n response: Injected response used to set cache headers.\\n background: Background task queue used for housekeeping.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A 201 payload with the issued code, the full short URL, the stored\\n (normalised) destination and ISO-8601 UTC timestamps.\\n\\n Raises:\\n ApiError: 400 for an invalid expiry or an invalid/unsafe destination,\\n 503 when no unique code could be allocated, 500 on datastore failure.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n days = active.default_expiry_days if payload.expires_in_days is None else payload.expires_in_days\\n if days < 1 or days > active.max_expiry_days:\\n raise ApiError(\\n 400,\\n \\\"expiry_out_of_range\\\",\\n \\\"expires_in_days must be a whole number between 1 and {0}.\\\".format(active.max_expiry_days),\\n )\\n\\n try:\\n destination, host = normalize_destination(payload.url, active)\\n validator.assert_routable(host)\\n except DestinationError as exc:\\n raise ApiError(400, exc.code, exc.message)\\n\\n created = utc_now()\\n expires = created + timedelta(days=days)\\n created_at = to_iso_z(created)\\n expires_at = to_iso_z(expires)\\n creator_ip = client_ip_for(request, active)\\n\\n issued_code: Optional[str] = None\\n for _ in range(max(1, active.code_max_attempts)):\\n candidate = generate_code(active.code_length)\\n try:\\n database.insert_link(\\n code=candidate,\\n destination=destination,\\n created_at=created_at,\\n expires_at=expires_at,\\n creator_ip=creator_ip,\\n )\\n except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\\n LOGGER.info(\\\"short code collision; retrying\\\")\\n continue\\n except sqlite3.Error:\\n LOGGER.error(\\\"link insert failed\\\")\\n raise ApiError(500, \\\"internal_error\\\", \\\"An internal error occurred.\\\")\\n issued_code = candidate\\n break\\n\\n if issued_code is None:\\n raise ApiError(503, \\\"code_generation_failed\\\", \\\"Could not allocate a unique short code; please retry.\\\")\\n\\n background.add_task(_run_purge, purger)\\n response.headers[\\\"Cache-Control\\\"] = \\\"no-store\\\"\\n return CreateLinkResponse(\\n code=issued_code,\\n short_url=\\\"{0}/{1}\\\".format(active.public_base_url, issued_code),\\n destination=destination,\\n created_at=created_at,\\n expires_at=expires_at,\\n )\\n\\n @app.get(\\\"/{code}\\\", tags=[\\\"links\\\"])\\n def resolve_link(code: str, background: BackgroundTasks) -> Response:\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"Resolve a short code to its stored destination.\\n\\n The Location header is always the destination this service validated and\\n stored itself; nothing from the incoming query string, headers or path is\\n ever used to build it.\\n\\n Args:\\n code: The short code from the request path.\\n background: Background task queue used for click analytics.\\n\\n Returns:\\n A 302 response whose ``Location`` is the exact stored destination, with\\n ``Cache-Control: no-store``.\\n\\n Raises:\\n ApiError: 404 when the code was never issued, 410 when the link has\\n expired, 502 when the destination no longer resolves to routable\\n space, 500 on datastore failure.\\n \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n if not is_plausible_code(code):\\n raise ApiError(404, \\\"not_found\\\", \\\"No link exists for that code.\\\")\\n\\n try:\\n row = uvicorn\\n\\n settings = load_settings()\\n uvicorn.run(\\n app,\\n host=settings.bind_host,\\n port=settings.bind_port,\\n log_level=settings.uvicorn_log_level,\\n )\\n\\n\\nif __name__ == \\\"__main__\\\": # pragma: no cover - process entrypoint\\n run()\\n\"}],\"notes\":\"Deviations and choices worth reviewing first:\\n\\n1. Redirect rate limiting. The design explicitly rejected rate limiting the redirect path, but the platform rule requires limiting both creation and redirects in one place. I implemented a single middleware that limits both: creation uses LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX exactly as specified, redirects use a derived allowance of 20 x LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX per window (REDIRECT_LIMIT_MULTIPLIER in app/config.py). No new environment variable was introduced, so the config list still binds exactly to the design. The generous multiplier preserves the design's intent that a viral link behind one NAT is not throttled.\\n\\n2. Health endpoint. The design's config/data model never named one. I added GET /healthz with GET /health as an alias; both return {status, service, time} and touch no user data or the datastore. They are registered before GET /{code} and are in RESERVED_PATHS so a 7-character path like \\\"healthz\\\" cannot be shadowed by the catch-all.\\n\\n3. Error body shape. One stable shape everywhere: {\\\"error\\\": <code>, \\\"code\\\": <code>, \\\"message\\\": <static text>, \\\"detail\\\": <same text>}. error and code are duplicated deliberately so either client convention reads the machine-readable code; detail exists because FastAPI clients commonly read it. Messages are static: they never echo the submitted URL, a resolved IP, a DB error, a stack trace or a path. Pydantic validation failures are converted to 400 invalid_request without including exc.errors(), precisely because those carry the raw input back.\\n\\n4. Expiry purge. The design mentions a periodic purge; a naive DELETE WHERE expires_at <= now would turn the required 410 into a 404. I purge only rows expired more than 30 days ago (ExpiryPurger grace_days), scheduled as a background task after creation and at most once per 300 s, so recently expired links keep answering 410.\\n\\n5. DNS failure is fail-closed: NXDOMAIN, resolver error, empty answer or timeout rejects the destination (400 destination_unresolvable at creation, 502 at redirect). LINKS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_DESTINATIONS=true short-circuits assert_routable entirely (no DNS, no range check) so tests can run hermetically; it is documented test-only and defaults to false.\\n\\n6. Denylist: attribute flags (loopback/private/link-local/multicast/reserved/unspecified) plus not-is_global plus explicit CIDR tables covering 0.0.0.0/8, 10/8, 100.64/10 (Python's is_private does not include it), 127/8, 169.254/16, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 224/4, 240/4, ::1, fc00::/7, fe80::/10, ff00::/8, 2001:db8::/32, 6to4/Teredo/NAT64 ranges, and IPv4-mapped/6to4/Teredo embedded addresses are unwrapped and re-checked. 169.254.169.254, 169.254.170.2 and fd00:ec2::254 are denied explicitly. Every resolved A and AAAA record must pass, not just the first, and the same check runs again at redirect time (anti-rebinding). No socket is ever opened to the destination.\\n\\n7. Normalization stores an ASCII-only URL (IDNA A-label host, lowercased, userinfo rejected outright, default port stripped, path/query/fragment percent-encoded with '%' in the safe set to avoid double encoding). This lets the redirect set Location to the byte-exact stored string via a plain Response rather than Starlette's RedirectResponse, which re-quotes the URL.\\n\\n8. Automatic trailing-slash redirects are disabled (app.router.redirect_slashes = False) so no Location can ever be derived from an incoming path segment.\\n\\n9. Configuration parsing degrades to the documented default (with a warning) on an unparsable or out-of-range value instead of crashing; LINKS_DEFAULT_EXPIRY_DAYS is clamped to LINKS_MAX_EXPIRY_DAYS. A non-https LINKS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL logs a warning and is accepted only if it is http(s); anything else falls back to the default. Trailing slashes are stripped at startup as specified.\\n\\n10. LINKS_DB_PATH=':memory:' uses one shared lock-protected connection (a per-call connection would lose the schema); file paths get a fresh WAL connection per operation. 'file::memory:' URIs are not supported.\\n\\n11. requirements.txt includes httpx and pytest because the generated test suite will need Starlette's TestClient; they are not imported by the service itself.\\n\"}", "tier": "deep"}

ValueError:\n pass\n return list(HOST_MAP.get(h, []))\n\n\ndef _fake_getaddrinfo(host, port, family=0, type=0, proto=0, flags=0):\n ips = _resolve(host)\n if not ips:\n raise -- internals ---------------------------------------------------------\n def _connect(self):\n if not os.path.exists(self.path):\n return None\n return sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=5)\n\n def _meta(self, con):\n tables = [\n r[0]\n for r in con.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\")\n if not str(r[0]).startswith(\"sqlite_\")\n ]\n for t in tables:\n cols = [r[1] for r in con.execute('PRAGMA table_info(\"%s\")' % t)]\n low = [c.lower() for c in cols]\n if \"code\" in low and any(d in low for d in DEST_COLS):\n return t, cols\n return None, []\n\n # -- API ---------------------------------------------------------------\n def rows(self):\n con = self._connect()\n if con is None:\n return []\n try:\n table, cols = self._meta(con)\n if table is None:\n return []\n out = []\n for r in con.execute('SELECT * FROM \"%s\"' % table):\n out.append({c.lower(): v for c, v in zip(cols, r)})\n return out\n finally:\n con.close()\n\n def count(self):\n return len(self.rows())\n\n def row_for(self, code):\n for r in self.rows():\n if r.get(\"code\") == code:\n return r\n return None\n\n def destination_of(self, row):\n for c in DEST_COLS:\n if c in row and row[c] is not None:\n return row[c]\n return None\n\n def click_count_of(self, code):\n row = self.row_for(code) or {}\n for c in CLICK_COLS:\n if c in row:\n return row[c]\n return None\n\n def set_expiry(self, code, iso_value):\n con = self._connect()\n assert con is not None, f\"no database file at {self.path}\"\n try:\n table, cols = self._meta(con)\n assert table is not None, \"no links table found in the database\"\n low = {c.lower(): c for c in cols}\n col = next((low[c] for c in EXPIRY_COLS if c in low), None)\n assert col is not None, f\"no expiry column among {cols}\"\n cur = con.execute(\n 'UPDATE \"%s\" SET \"%s\" = ? {\n \"generatecode\",\n \"gencode\",\n \"newcode\",\n \"makecode\",\n \"randomcode\",\n \"shortcode\",\n \"generateshortcode\",\n \"makeshortcode\",\n \"newshortcode\",\n \"randomshortcode\",\n \"createcode\",\n \"generateuniquecode\",\n \"codegenerator\",\n \"generatecandidate\",\n}\n\n\ndef find_code_generators():\n \"\"\"Every module-level callable in the project that looks like the code generator.\"\"\"\n found = []\n for mod in list(sys.modules.values()):\n if not isinstance(mod, types.ModuleType) or not _is_project_module(mod):\n continue\n for attr in list(vars(mod)):\n norm = attr.replace(\"_\", \"\").lower()\n if norm in CODE_FN_NAMES and callable(getattr(mod, attr, None)):\n found.append((mod, attr))\n return found\n\n\ndef code_of(body):\n if not isinstance(body, dict):\n return None\n for key in (\"code\", \"short_code\", \"shortCode\", \"slug\", \"key\"):\n v = body.get(key)\n if isinstance(v, str) and v:\n return v\n for key in (\"short_url\", \"shortUrl\", \"short_link\", \"url\"):\n v = body.get(key)\n if isinstance(v, str) and \"/\" in v:\n return v.rstrip(\"/\").rsplit(\"/\", 1)[-1]\n return None\n\n\ndef short_url_of(body):\n for key in (\"short_url\", \"shortUrl\", \"short_link\"):\n v = body.get(key)\n if isinstance(v, str):\n return v\n return None\n\n\ndef error_code(resp):\n try:\n body = resp.json()\n except Exception:\n return None\n if isinstance(body, dict):\n for key in (\"error_code\", \"errorCode\", \"code\", \"error\"):\n v = body.get(key)\n if isinstance(v, str) and v:\n return v\n detail = body.get(\"detail\")\n if isinstance(detail, str) and detail:\n return detail\n if isinstance(detail, dict):\n for key in (\"error_code\", \"errorCode\", \"code\", \"error\"):\n v = detail.get(key)\n if isinstance(v, str) and v:\n return v\n return None\n\n\ndef parse_iso(value):\n assert isinstance(value, str) and value, f\"expected an ISO-8601 string, got {value!r}\"\n text = value.strip()\n assert text.endswith(\"Z\") or \"+\" in text, f\"expected a UTC timestamp, got {value!r}\"\n if text.endswith(\"Z\"):\n text = text[:-1] + \"+00:00\"\n return _dt.datetime.fromisoformat(text)\n\n\ndef wait_until(predicate, pump, tries=30):\n \"\"\"Poll a predicate, pumping the event loop with a cheap request. Never sleeps.\"\"\"\n value = predicate()\n for _ in range(tries):\n if value:\n return value\n pump()\n value = predicate()\n return value\n\n\nclass ScriptedRandom:\n \"\"\"Deterministic replacement
